comparisons.peer_summary: AMD provides CPUs, APUs, and chipsets for desktops and notebooks with AI capabilities and security features, and uses GPUs with software to power immersive gaming experiences.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies address the specific driver of AI capabilities in next-generation PCs requiring enhanced hardware performance. Micron (MU) highlights the resulting demand for higher performance and capacity SSDs, expanding its portfolio with the G8 NAND-based 3500 NVMe SSD to handle demanding workloads. AMD (AMD) similarly identifies the need for AI capabilities in desktops and notebooks, driving innovation in its CPUs, APUs, and chipsets to support these performance demands for gamers, creators, and enterprises.

sentences.text: PC: The next generation PCs contain high-performance neural processing chipsets as well as AI capabilities and require higher performance and higher average capacity SSDs than traditional PCs.
In 2024, we expanded our technology portfolio with the 3500 NVMe SSD, our first performance client SSD built on Micron G8 NAND.

We drive innovation with our line-up of CPUs, APUs and chipsets for desktops and notebooks, to bring performance, efficiency, AI capabilities and modern security features to gamers, creators, consumers and enterprises.

comparisons.peer_topic: Client CPU product launches and performance
comparisons.peer_summary: In 2024, Intel launched Intel Core Ultra Series 1 (first with integrated NPU for AI workloads) and the power-efficient Intel Core Ultra 200V Series. Additionally, the 13th and 14th Gen Intel Core processors continued to serve a significant majority of client sales.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures focus on the launch of new client computing products in 2024 driven by AI capabilities. Intel (INTC) ramped sales of the Intel Core Ultra Series 1, described as the first product with an integrated NPU for AI workloads, introducing the 'first AI PCs'. Similarly, Micron (MU) expanded its client SSD portfolio with the 3500 NVMe SSD, explicitly designed to help customers handle 'demanding workloads' associated with the 'next generation PCs' that contain 'AI capabilities'.

sentences.text: In 2024, we expanded our technology portfolio with the 3500 NVMe SSD, our first performance client SSD built on Micron G8 NAND.
This original SSD will help our customers handle demanding workloads for business applications, scientific computing, gaming, and content creation.

▪Client CPUs. In 2024, we ramped sales of the Intel® Core™ Ultra Series 1, our first product with an integrated neural processing unit for efficient processing of AI workload. The Intel Core Ultra Series 1, manufactured on the Intel 4 process, introduced the first AI PCs to the market. We also launched the Intel Core Ultra 200V Series, showcasing power efficiency and long-lasting battery life. The 200V Series, manufactured by an external foundry, leverages our Xe2 GPU architecture, bringing improved efficiency, second-generation ray tracing units and XMX AI acceleration to thin and light notebooks. During 2024, a significant majority of our client sales consisted of our 13th and 14th Gen Intel Core processors, manufactured on Intel 7, which allow us to serve the breadth of customer and computing needs in the client market.

comparisons.peer_topic: NVIDIA RTX Technology and AI Integration
comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA RTX enhances gaming through real-time ray tracing for cinematic-quality rendering and DLSS, an AI technology that boosts frame rates, positioning RTX as the AI PC leader with over 100 million AI-capable PCs and 500+ enabled applications.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies identify 'AI PC' as a key market trend and product category. Micron (MU) states that 'next generation PCs' require higher performance due to 'AI capabilities', prompting the launch of its 3500 NVMe SSD. NVIDIA (NVDA) positions its RTX GPUs as the 'AI PC leader' with over 100 million 'AI capable PCs' installed, leveraging AI technology like DLSS to enhance gaming and other applications on these devices.

sentences.text: PC: The next generation PCs contain high-performance neural processing chipsets as well as AI capabilities and require higher performance and higher average capacity SSDs than traditional PCs.

Our client SSDs, targeted for leading personal computer OEMs, have mostly replaced hard disk drives used in notebooks, desktops, workstations, and other consumer applications, and deliver high performance, power efficiency, security, and capacity.
NVIDIA RTX also features deep learning super sampling, or NVIDIA DLSS, our AI technology that boosts frame rates while generating beautiful, sharp images for games.
With an installed base of over 100 million AI capable PCs, more than 500 RTX AI-enabled applications and games, and a robust suite of development tools, RTX is already the AI PC leader.
